name: Mourning Residue
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The residue can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the residue has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The residue makes two Caress attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Stolen Joy.

Actions.name: Caress
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 41 (8d8 + 5) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Stolen Joy
Actions.text: *Charisma Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: The residue reaches into the target's happiest memory, forcing a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the target is Frig

lore: It is the residue of a mourning that refused to end, drifting the world to feed its endless ache on the warm and joyful.

generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
